## Fixed

- **Words running together in the help pages — the real cause.** v2.83-dev
  fixed a handful of these, but missed most of them. The underlying problem
  turned out to be the compiler, not the wording: whenever a help sentence
  contained a typographic character — a curly apostrophe, an em dash, smart
  quotes, an arrow — the build silently dropped the space that followed the
  nearest bold or code-styled word. So "Click **View** on any row" was written
  correctly all along, but shipped as "Click **View**on any row".

  Because the trigger was punctuation elsewhere in the same sentence, the fault
  showed up in seemingly random places and never in a way you could see by
  reading the source. Every occurrence is now fixed and pinned so the compiler
  cannot drop it again: **148** spots across all 29 help pages, verified by
  compiling the help text the same way the production build does and checking
  that no highlighted word is left touching the next one.

- **The same fault in three admin pages.** Five more places outside the help
  system were affected — the wording about merging first and last name columns
  on the Import page, two lines on the Backup page describing what a portable
  backup contains, and the imported-file summary line on the Import Aliases
  tab. All corrected.

Wording and spacing only — no behaviour, data or settings were changed.
